radius.$description: The persons module rounds the portrait into a circle; in Medicalify it is a plain photo.

maxWidth.$description: The persons module caps the portrait at 100px; in Medicalify it fills the card, see the thumbnail sizes in hugo.yml.

ratio.$description: --bs-aspect-ratio: 150% in the Bootstrap layer. The 306x398 thumbnails of hugo.yml are cropped to it.
